title: Akira
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Neo-Tokyo, rebuilt after a mysterious explosion destroyed Tokyo, teenage biker gang leader Kaneda watches his friend Tetsuo gain overwhelming psychic powers from a secret government project. As Tetsuo seeks to awaken Akira, the psychic behind the original catastrophe, the city is torn apart by the military, resistance fighters, cults and Tetsuo's own rampage.
life_message: It warns against power without restraint and institutions that exploit the young, while holding up friendship and the possibility of renewal after ruin.

content.note: Mass killing, gang and military violence, city-scale destruction and body horror (Wikipedia; AniList Gore, War, Terrorism tags).
Apocalyptic destruction, grotesque bodily transformation and survival horror (Wikipedia; Horror genre, AniList Body Horror, Post-Apocalyptic).
A character is taken as one of Tetsuo's 'sex slaves' (Wikipedia); sexual coercion implied; explicitness to verify.
Frequent profanity among gangs and soldiers; capped (to verify).
Tetsuo's dependence on pills and withdrawal, a junkie gang, drugged rations, alcoholism (Wikipedia; AniList Drugs tag).
Youth alienation, isolation and loss of self (to verify on self-harm).
Reckless motorcycle gangs, drug use and terrorism shown with heavy costs (Wikipedia; AniList Delinquents, Gangs, Motorcycles tags).

delivery.evidence: ANN reviewers: political and angry (Price), yet the politics can be ignored by readers (Loveridge); not called preachy.
delivery.note: Its warnings about power and authority are carried by the city's destruction rather than speeches, per reviewers.

winners_losers: Military and government secrecy and Tetsuo's unchecked power both lead to ruin; Kaneda and survivors rebuild. Sympathy goes to youth and survivors against authoritarian institutions.
